description_en: Creates a model creation operator sub-service
name: CreateModelOperatorService

parameters.help_en: The ID of the region to which the service belongs. This parameter is required and must be consistent with the request endpoint and the purchase region
parameters.help_zh: 服务所属的地域 ID。必填，必须与请求接入点和购买地域一致
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The number of compute resource CUs for the model creation operator sub-service. The value must be an integer greater than 0. The available specifications and prices are subject to the actual sales configurations in the target region
parameters.help_zh: 模型算子服务的计算资源 CU 数，必须为大于 0 的整数。可购买规格及价格以目标地域实际售卖配置为准
parameters.name: cu

parameters.help_en:
The billing method. Valid values:
PostPay: pay-as-you-go. This is the default value.
PrePay: subscription. You must also specify UsedTime and Period
parameters.help_zh:
付费类型。取值：

PostPay：按量付费，默认值。
PrePay：包年包月，须同时填写 UsedTime 和 Period
parameters.name: pay_type

parameters.help_en: The subscription duration. This parameter is required when PayType is set to PrePay. The value must be a positive integer string, and the unit is specified by Period. The actual available duration is subject to the sales configurations. This parameter is not required for pay-as-you-go
parameters.help_zh: 购买时长。PayType 为 PrePay 时必填，必须为正整数字符串，单位由 Period 指定；实际可购买时长以售卖配置为准。按量付费无需填写
parameters.name: used_time

parameters.help_en: The unit of the subscription duration. This parameter is required when PayType is set to PrePay. Valid values: Month and Year. This parameter is used together with UsedTime and is not required for pay-as-you-go
parameters.help_zh: 购买时长单位。PayType 为 PrePay 时必填：Month 表示月，Year 表示年。与 UsedTime 配合使用；按量付费无需填写
parameters.name: period

OrderId.description_en: The ID of the sales order generated when the model creation operator sub-service is created
OrderId.description_zh: 创建模型算子服务产生的售卖订单 ID

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the request, which is used to locate and troubleshoot the request
RequestId.description_zh: 请求 ID，用于定位和排查本次请求

ServiceId.description_en: The ID of the model operator service corresponding to the sales order. The return of this ID does not indicate that the service has been activated. You can call ListModelOperatorServices to query the subsequent status
ServiceId.description_zh: 售卖订单对应的模型算子服务 ID。返回该 ID 不表示服务已经完成开通，可通过 ListModelOperatorServices 查询后续状态
